name: Dida 365
author: Daniel (fork of Ehsanul Haque Siam's siam.ticktick)
description: Dida365 (滴答清单) tasks in the Omarchy bar — smart lists, lists and folders, due counts that ignore notes, natural-language quick add, and full task editing without leaving the keyboard.

barWidget.description: Overdue and due-today task count — notes excluded — with a keyboard-driven popup to browse smart lists, complete, edit, and quick-add tasks. Targets api.dida365.com by default.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the widget polls TickTick. Actions refresh immediately regardless.

schema.label: Upcoming window (days)
schema.description: How far ahead the Next view reaches. 0 shows today only.

schema.label: Completed window (days)
schema.description: How far back the Done view looks for finished tasks.

schema.label: Sort tasks by
schema.description: Also decides the section headings: List heads each group with its list name, Date with Overdue/Today/Tomorrow.

schema.label: Bar badge counts
schema.description: Which tasks the number next to the bar icon counts.

schema.label: Default view
schema.description: Which view the popup opens on.

schema.label: Quick-add project id
schema.description: Project id new tasks go to. Leave blank for your Inbox. Run 'ticktick projects' to list ids.

schema.label: Hide when nothing is due
schema.description: Remove the widget from the bar entirely while the badge count is zero.

schema.label: Show project names
schema.description: Show which project each task belongs to on its row.

schema.label: Include undated tasks
schema.description: Show tasks with no due date in the All view.

schema.label: Confirm before deleting
schema.description: Deleting a task is permanent and cannot be undone through the API.

schema.label: Show habits
schema.description: A Habits view with today's check-in state, streaks, and a count in the bar.

schema.label: Show statistics
schema.description: A Stats view: completed-per-day trend, open work by list, notes, priority and tag, plus habit and focus summaries.

schema.label: Show the focus timer
schema.description: A pomodoro strip in the panel, with a live countdown in the bar while a block runs.

schema.label: Focus length (minutes)
schema.description: How long a focus block runs. 0 uses 25 minutes. The account has no focus settings of its own to defer to.

schema.label: Short break (minutes)
schema.description: The break after a focus block. 0 uses 5 minutes.

schema.label: Long break (minutes)
schema.description: The break taken every few blocks. 0 uses 15 minutes.

schema.label: Long break every N blocks
schema.description: How many focus blocks earn a long break. 0 uses 4.
